avis.texte: I began using Peter Thomas Roth Peptide Skinjection products three weeks ago, and I have already seen significant improvements in my skin. The wrinkles have been greatly reduced. I will continue using these products indefinitely and I recommend this brand. Thank you, Peter Thomas Roth!

its a great serum. however, the amount of product you're getting will not last you more than a month. The bottle its in is deceptive. Its very shallow. with hardly any serum in it. The plastic bottle gives the illusion of more product in the bottle. Very Very sneaky of this brand and i will not buy this product again.

So amazing I can't tell you how much this stuff has helped my smile lines. I can't even believe it sometimes how well this stuff works. Great for my face! I'm 52, but loving it for my neck to hold off any turkey neck!

I hope you reconsider that Or create something comparable. Also to ask about how I identify is a ridiculous question you need to eliminate! Get real!!

avis.titre: Not an enough of a noticeable difference for the price.
avis.texte: I received the Peter Thomas Roth | Peptide Skinjection Gel Patches for free and gave them a try. While they did not feel slimy or sticky and left my skin feeling fresh and cool, I did not see a significant difference in the lines around my eyes or nose.

Peter Thomas Roth's Peptide Expression Line Hydra-Gel Patches: I've loved Peter Thomas Roth masks for a long time, so I was so excited to try out the new peptide Skinjection Expression Line hydra-gel patches which target expression lines. I love how these are easy to apply and actually stay on the skin without sliding around. They come in two different shapes to help fit your skin the best. They give my skin the prettiest glow and my skin feels so hydrated. It's been a skin saver this winter! I got to try out this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

Peter Thomas Roth Peptide Skinjection Expression Line Hidra-Gel Patches: I love the patches with Peptide E-lift peptide 2%. They help reduce expression lines, helps with uneven skin tone, help provide hydration and I now have brighter and more moisturized skin. I loved them, and once I figured out how to use them, they stay in place easily. Try leaving them on for at least 10 to 15 minutes and then pat the serum in when you remove them. I forgot to mention the cool little spatula that you use to take them out of the container. Be gentle, they are a little fragile.

Peter Thomas Roth. Peptide Skinjection Expression Line Hidra-Gel Patches: I loved its very colorful packaging, they are gelatinous patches with Peptide E-lift peptide 2%: helps reduce expression lines, Niacinamide: which helps with uneven skin tone, Cactus flower, Squalane, Hyaluronic acid: which help provide hydration and have brighter and more moisturized skin. I loved them, they are fragrance-free patches that adapt perfectly to the area where you like to put them, they stick very well and stay in place easily. How to use: personally, I like to use them at night after my skin care routine, I love leaving them on for at least 10 to 15 minutes and then removing them, they are patches that feel very fresh when using them and the best thing is that you can place them in the area that you yourself feel you need them, they are very comfortable, they do not irritate the skin, you can even do your normal activities without them moving from the place you placed them. they are perfect, I loved them.

I got to try Peter Thomas Roth's Peptide Expression Line Hydra-Gel Patches for free, and I'm honestly loving them! ✨ I wasn't sure what to expect, but after using them, my skin around my eyes and brows feels so much smoother, and my expression lines are less noticeable. They feel super refreshing and hydrating, and I love how easy they are to use. The patches stay in place, and there's no scent at all, which is perfect for me. After just 15 minutes, I noticed my skin looking more lifted and fresh. These are definitely staying in my routine! 🌟

These patches are a nice addition to the under eye patches. While they didn't change the way the lines on my face look, they did feel extremely cooling and moisturizing during and after use. There was no scent, which was perfect. Although they are a bit pricey, it'd be a good intro product for someone looking to dip their toe into those types of products.

These patches are a nice addition to the under eye patches. While they didn't change the way the lines on my face look, they did feel extremely cooling and moisturizing during and after use. Since I purchased the Peter Thomas Roth peptide skinjectiin I have and will being keeping this in my makeup and skin care routine!! Fabulous product

I did buy in person vs online… not sure if that made a difference in which batch i received

avis.titre: you replaced my favorite serum with this!
avis.texte: You replaced my favorite serum, the wrinkles resist serum with this terrible product! the new version is drying, it stings and makes my skin feel and look dryer and older.

This product works ! Deep crow wrinkles around my mouth showed definite improvements within days. Upper lip showed drastic improvements. Lower lip with deeper wrinkles have gradually decreased within 1-2 weeks. Full face shows smoother skin. Still using in 3rd week and expect a month time gone by will continue to improve. Used normal portions overall with extra in creases. First product I will be happy to continue using. Also for the price compared to other products I purchased that did not show any changes were doubled the price of this generous bottle size. Each person has different skin and defects to improve on. I would definitely recommend trying this one. I know you will be happy with results.
I 💯 don't understand who's reviewing this with all the negativity. I'm in late 40's and this is amazing stuff! My fellow mature ladies, its now a necessity 💖

avis.titre: Small amount of product in defective container
avis.texte: I received a small amount of the product in the bottle and no inside connector to the pump. So I had to open the container for the product. I have enjoyed many of PTR products but this was a disappointment.

The serum itself is quite nice but it is such a struggle to get it out of the bottle that it is not worth the time and effort. Maybe I got a bad bottle, but the bottle itself it too big for the amount of product inside. I believe it is supposed to be refillable, but the bottle comes apart every time I use it and the pump pumps nothing. Perhaps there is supposed to be a tube inside to feed the serum up to the pump, but mine has nothing connected to the pump so you have to shake the serum up to try to get anything out of it. I finally gave up and just have the inside of the bottle sitting upside down on the cap and have to slam it against my hand to get the serum out. Very frustrating. If the packaging was smaller for the amount inside and I could actually get the product out of the bottle without so much time and effort, I might consider buying it again, but NOT as long as it comes in this ridiculous bottle.

avis.titre: I want more of this amazing product for my face
avis.texte: Love to use it right after my night ritual of shower cleaning my face it works good for me and everyone that uses it daily for face I love it for my night ritual and then my moisturizer 🧴 Ventura California

Im so confused by all the negative reviews bec this product works amazingly well with my sensitive, acne prone skin. I had initially recieved it as a sample from another purchase and the difference its made in my skin, even with just a handful of uses, is undeniable. This product is gifted by Peterthomasroth. What stands out most about this serum is its ability to smooth out fine lines and wrinkles. After consistent use, I've noticed that the fine lines around my eyes and mouth appear less pronounced, giving my skin a more youthful look. The serum absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and plump without any greasy residue.

This serum is great for stabilizing your skin, adding nourishment, and improving your skin barrier. The peptide component provides substantial benefits without feeling weighty. I love the bottle's refillable concept, yet it may be improved because the refillable component is very large and does not appear to minimize waste considerably. It's gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

PTR products are usually good so I was excited to try their wrinkle free serum complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. The serum has a soft milky texture and has helped smooth out my fine lines as well as moisturize

This was gifted by peterthomasroth. It goes on smoothly, no fragrant and a bit drying. I have not noticed any sort of reduction of lines but it it's only been 12 days since l've begun to use it. My skin took moisturizer easily after application of this product. My skin did not feel oily after applying, that was a plus. No fragrance. No wait time between applying this product and then moisturizer, sun block or makeup. To be fair, I am 60 and have not had any skin injections prior to using. The product is marketed to folks who want to stretch out the time between skin injection procedures. I am not sure that I will keep using this after the review.

I have been using the new Peptide Skinjection Amplified Wrinkle-Fix Serum from PTP twice a day for two weeks, and I'm really impressed with the results! My fine lines and wrinkles are much less visible, and my skin feels incredibly soft and firm! Gifted by peterthomasroth.

This peptide serum is great for preventing new lines and improving skin texture in aging skin. The concentrated amount of peptide does its job to improve wrinkles and prevent new ones from forming. I have combination sensitive skin and this serum didn't irritate it. It also soaked in fast and didn't leave any residue. I highly recommend adding this serum to your routine! I received this product complimentary from peterthomasroth.

I doubt that I will be purchasing this product. I may or may not continue using it.

The Peptide Skinjection Apmplified Wrinkle Fix Serum is a great product. The texture is a little gritty, however it is just something to get used to. I was gifted by peter Thomas Roth and I can't wait to continue to incorporate this into my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Made my skin noticeably smoother and softer
avis.texte: I've been using the Peter Thomas Roth Peptide Skinjection Amplified Wrinkle- Fix Serum. I have mostly used it on my forehead where I have a lot of fine lines turning into wrinkles. And also around my eyes where I have crows feet. I've notified a good amount of change in my facial skin. It's become smoother and softer while using this product. With continued use I'm looking to see my fine lines start disappearing. The product was easy to disturbs, easy to apply and absorbed into my skin quickly. I received this product as a gift which was offered by Peter Thomas Roth.

I was so grateful to receive this product complimentary from peterthomasroth in exchange for my honest review because I know Matrixyl® and Argireline have a wealth of scientific studies that show they are effective and helpful in firming the skin and changing the appearance of pores. I was excited to see what it would do for my skin! After testing it my honest review is that while I can't testify to whether it helps you to extend the time between injectibles because I'm a natural/no filler girlie I can say that i thoroughly enjoyed the texture of this serum and how absolutely effortlessly it sinks into the skin. I feel as though I saw hopeful improvement of my fine lines and I will keep using it. It's a great serum!

I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth The Peptide Serum for review. The Peptide Skinjection is very effective, you don't need more than 3x a week if your skin is dry. Really like this peptide serum it was very hydrating and it lasted all day long. This price of this product is also very affordable and easy to use. Truly recommend using all of this products from this brand. Gifted by peterthimasroth
